title: On-Device Intelligence Empowers People with Disabilities and Smart Interaction Scenarios
summary: Vivo describes on-device speech, vision, and sign-language features that work offline. Their direct accessibility benefits are reported; wider social effects are unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Vivo describes on-device speech, vision, and sign-language features that work offline. Their direct accessibility benefits are reported; wider social effects are unmeasured. Mobile accessibility product features. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Help disabled and multilingual users communicate and access information offline.

ratings.reason: The provider reports offline speech, vision, and sign-language assistance that expands communication and information access. Population figures do not establish lasting outcomes for every user.
A 90% reduction in cloud energy use is asserted, but total device-plus-cloud energy and net environmental effects are not measured.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: On-Device Intelligence Empowers People with Disabilities and Smart Interaction Scenarios

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Accessible input/output interfaces and supported languages

headline: Vivo adds offline AI accessibility tools

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
